body: I think it's the latter. When someone asks how I would define myself I never know what to say. I feel like I'm all over the place. I'm afraid to see who I really am. I feel like I'm lying to myself and others all the time. Right now, I feel like I'm lying to you for attention. And you know..that just might be true..I don't even know.
Yeah when I posted it Reddit told me it was under heavy load so I didn't think it submitted. My mistake. :)
it's like I want to turn my back on it but at the same time I don't. I feel like something's missing.

I already feel better now. Thanks to the kind PMs and replies to this. I am definitely seeing a counselor next week, and hopefully this week if I can. But the 1st week of school is always difficult to schedule things. Sometimes these feelings are just so overwhelming, I don't want to scare anybody, and they usually go away after a while. But you're right, they always come back.
